participation.context: Gave the current correction, stayed in bed, and did not make a virtue of it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Had the part learned, took the word, and refused the reason.
participation.name: Richard Cowley

participation.context: Stopped him at the chair and set bread and broth between them.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

relations.quote: A reason will not help an entrance.

story.body: Cowley had the part. You named the second correction, Ephesus not Epidamnum at the third speech, and told him not to mend the book. He said a reason will not help an entrance. Mistress Ansell put bread and broth between you and kept him to the chair. You stayed in bed. Errors at two was his to play, and nobody made it a story about you.

relations.quote: A reason will not help an entrance.

title: Told Cowley Ephesus at the third speech and stayed in bed
